name: Viber Bulk Number Profile
description: Upload numbers and download the Viber profile data, avatar included.

result_fields.name: number
result_fields.description: The submitted number, exactly as it appeared in your file.

result_fields.name: activated
result_fields.description: Whether the number is registered on Viber.

result_fields.name: nickname
result_fields.description: Public display name on the profile.

result_fields.name: last_online_time
result_fields.description: The most recent online time observed.

result_fields.name: active_days
result_fields.description: Days since that activity — smaller is more recent.

result_fields.name: avatar_type
result_fields.description: What the avatar picture appears to contain, e.g. a single person.

result_fields.name: person_count
result_fields.description: How many people were detected in the avatar.

result_fields.name: age
result_fields.description: Age band estimated from the avatar.

result_fields.name: skin_color
result_fields.description: Skin tone estimated from the avatar.
